title: chamaeraphis setosa var. macrostachya
intro: Chamaeraphis setosa var. macrostachya, commonly known as White Peony or Zhi Bai He, is a type of plant used in traditional Chinese medicine, belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. It is believed to possess various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with menstrual disorders, as well as its antioxidant properties that may contribute to overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of White Peony are thought to be attributed to its ability to cool and calm the body, as well as its capacity to regulate menstrual cycles and alleviate pain. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are reported to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
